verdict.rationale: Pylon clearly documents unified support across chat (widget + mobile SDK), email, in-app, and Slack (including Slack Connect and multi-workspace tracking), and generally claims omnichannel coverage. However, no evidence specifically confirms WhatsApp or social media channel integrations (e.g., Twitter/Instagram/Facebook), which the story explicitly calls out. Missing for 10: explicit WhatsApp support, explicit social-media channel integrations.
